intro.paragraph1: I'm an AI Software Engineer and PHP backend / full-stack developer with {years}+ years of experience building enterprise web applications, internal platforms and database-driven business systems. My core stack is PHP (Yii, Laravel, Symfony), MySQL/MariaDB, REST APIs, Docker and CI/CD.
intro.paragraph2: Today I work on a central business platform used across a group of companies for customers, tickets, offers, orders, invoicing, projects and time tracking. I bring AI into everyday workflows, such as AI-based ticket assignment and an AI-assisted search across customer history, and build new modules like an in-house HR and time-tracking system. Earlier, I led a team of five developers and developed an Education Management Information System. Throughout, I care about clean, testable code, safe data handling and reliable releases.

skills.mission: I build business software that solves real problems: solid engineering, reliable integrations and practical AI, delivered as maintainable, production-ready code.

entries.summary: Bringing AI into the company's central business platform and building new modules: the same platform I developed at APS Services, now full-time and with a wider scope.
highlights: Built an in-house HR module replacing an external time-tracking tool: clock-in/out with breaks, time accounts with target hours, public holidays and statutory break rules, a live attendance overview, logged time corrections, and vacation and absence management.
Developed AI features for the platform, including AI-based ticket assignment suggestions with server-side access control.
Designed and built an AI-assisted search across customer history (tickets and order items).
Integrated a telephony system and moved the UI to a modern Bootstrap 5 admin template.
Ensured production quality through code reviews, automated tests and concurrency-safe database transactions.

entries.summary: Developed and maintained the group's central business platform (customers, tickets, offers, orders, invoicing, projects, time tracking and reporting), running as separate instances for several group companies.
highlights: Built REST integrations, including DATEV-related workflows, and contributed to authentication, role-based access control and internal process automation.
Developed reporting, export and dashboard features; improved performance through query optimization and removal of N+1 queries.
Modernized legacy areas through OOP refactoring, automated tests and continuous integration.
Built responsive AJAX-based interfaces for day-to-day operations across multiple modules.

entries.summary: Led a team of five through the design, development, deployment and support of business web applications, while staying hands-on in development.
highlights: Designed REST APIs and relational database schemas for growing data volumes; managed deployments on Docker and Linux/CentOS with CI/CD.
Ran code reviews, set coding standards and wrote technical documentation; turned client requirements into deliverable solutions.

entries.summary: Developed frontend and backend features for client web applications in PHP and JavaScript.
highlights: Acted as the team's point of contact when leads were absent, keeping coordination and delivery on track.

entries.summary: Developed and maintained the school's Education Management Information System in PHP, covering student, staff, finance and user-administration modules.
highlights: Managed the relational database with a focus on data integrity and performance.
Implemented authentication and role-based access control for administrators and staff.
Worked with school management on requirements, new features and fixes; carried out system upgrades and troubleshooting.

entries.summary: Contributed to full-stack feature development: PHP backend logic and HTML/CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap frontends.
highlights: Supported deployments, technical documentation, user training and client presentations.

items.title: Enterprise Management System
items.description: Central business platform for customers, tickets, offers, orders, invoicing, projects and time tracking, running for several group companies, with DATEV integration, ZUGFeRD e-invoicing, AI features and an in-house HR module.

developmentDetails.label: Architecture
developmentDetails.text: Structured as a multi-module Yii application to keep admin workflows, document handling, and integrations isolated and maintainable.

developmentDetails.label: Data & Compliance
developmentDetails.text: Implemented DATEV and ZUGFeRD flows to support finance-oriented document exchange with consistent data handling.

developmentDetails.label: AI & New Modules
developmentDetails.text: Added AI-based ticket assignment suggestions and an AI-assisted search across customer history, plus an in-house HR module for time tracking, absences and attendance.

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Gives operations teams a centralized workspace for project tracking, document processing, and multilingual collaboration.

items.title: Education Management Information System

developmentDetails.label: Architecture
developmentDetails.text: Organized around school administration workflows so admissions, records, and finance modules could evolve independently.

developmentDetails.label: Data Management
developmentDetails.text: Designed around student, staff, and parent records with reporting-ready structures for administrative visibility.

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Reduced manual coordination by bringing academic, parent-facing, and finance processes into one system.

items.title: Donor Management System

developmentDetails.label: Architecture

developmentDetails.label: Business Value

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Provides a scalable, containerized analytics engine ready to plug into larger e-commerce or media architectures.

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Improves delivery coordination by giving teams a shared space for tasks, ownership, and progress tracking.

developmentDetails.label: Architecture
developmentDetails.text: A React and Vite page pre-rendered to static HTML at build time, then hydrated, so content appears before JavaScript loads.

developmentDetails.label: Automation Workflow
developmentDetails.text: EmailJS routes contact messages into a branded notification and auto-reply; GitHub Actions deploys each merge and creates versioned releases.

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Fast, accessible and easy to keep current, with content managed in one place for both languages.

developmentDetails.label: Business Value
developmentDetails.text: Provides a lightweight financial utility with current exchange data and a simple user experience.
